perks.name: Iaido
perks.description: Final blows with freshly drawn or reloaded weapons heal you.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Weapon Kill within 4 seconds of reloading or readying a weapon:
Restores 40 HP.
Incurs a 3 second cooldown upon triggering. Must reload or swap weapons after the cooldown is over for the effect to trigger on kill.

perks.name: Unfaltering Focus
perks.description: Bow, Shotgun, or Sword final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage. Damaging targets with those weapons extends the effect.
perks.exact:
On Bow, Shotgun, or Sword Kill:
Resist x1 (10% | 2.5%) for 7 seconds.
Dealing additional Weapon Damage extends the buff duration by +2 seconds, up to 10 seconds.

archetype.name: Specialist
archetype.description:
Armor configured for Guardians who seek a flexible approach to combat.

Primary Stat: Class
Secondary Stat: Weapons

item.name: Balanced Tuning
item.description: Slightly increases the three lowest stats on this armor at no cost.

item.name: Void Loader
item.description: Increases reload speed of Void weapons.
item.exact:
To Mod-Element Matching Weapon, after ~0.5 second of readying the weapon:

+10 | +15 | +18 Reload Speed
0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

item.name: Firepower
item.description: Your grenade final blows create Orbs of Power.
item.exact:
On Grenade Kill:
Spawns a Orb of Power.

Orb of Power:
0.8% | 1.1% | 1.25% | 1.5% Super Energy.

Incurs a 10 | 5 | 1 second cooldown between Orbs.
Can trigger alongside Heavy Handed if equipped before it.
From left to right order.

item.name: Impact Induction
item.description: Causing damage with a powered melee attack reduces your grenade cooldown.
item.exact:
Upon dealing Powered Melee Damage:
Grants Grenade Ability Energy.

Ability Energy Gain:
12% | 17% | 20%
6% | 8.5% | 10%

Incurs a 7 second cooldown after activation.
